description:
Get the public proof for one graded book: signed payload, hash, signature, content address and timestamp
    material, with the steps to check them. From 2026-04-28 on, a book is made after the close on its trading date
    (earlier books are a backtest, built later), and its return runs from that close over the next ten NYSE sessions
    (books before 2026-10-21 run from the first available close on or after that date over the next ten available
    sessions; the backtest books dated 2026-01-02 to 2026-04-13 run from the close before their date to nine sessions
    after it). The OpenTimestamps receipt proves the book existed before the Bitcoin block it names: compare that
    block's time with the next NYSE open after the trading date. sealed is true only while a book is still withheld.
    Every book served here is graded and revealed, so sealed is false, and that is not a failed check. The verified
    field is the server's own check of the hash and signature, not the timestamp; the evidence lets you repeat it
    yourself. Use this to check a book's signature and timestamp, and get_resolved_batch to read its forecasts and
    outcomes. An ungraded or unknown date is an error.

trading_date.description: The book's trading date, as YYYY-MM-DD. list_resolved_batches gives the graded dates.
